verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="components/spaces/email/composer-shell.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error("SCAN-703: missing "+f);process.exit(79)}const c=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const a=c.indexOf("function handleSend"),b=c.indexOf("function handleSchedule");if(a<0||b<0){console.error("SCAN-703: handleSend/handleSchedule not found in the composer; re-anchor the probe.");process.exit(79)}const send=c.slice(a,b);const resets=/setSubject\(\s*""\s*\)|setSubject\(\s*\x27\x27\s*\)/.test(send);const reuse=/draftId/.test(c);if(!resets||!reuse){console.error("SCAN-703: after a successful Send now the composer keeps subject and body filled (reset="+resets+") and every click creates a fresh campaign row (draft reuse="+reuse+"), so a second click sends the whole campaign to every contact again.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: handleSend in components/spaces/email/composer-shell.tsx left the subject and body in place after a successful send and ensureDraft created a new campaign row on every click, so a second Send now click made a fresh campaign and mailed every contact again (the server's already-gone-out check only sees the row it is given, and the per-recipient idempotency key carries the campaign id). The composer now keeps one draftId in state: the first click creates the draft and stores its id, every later click updates that same row, and a successful send or schedule empties subject, body, when and clears draftId, so a retry after a failure reuses the row and a repeat click after success has nothing to send. Pinned by components/spaces/email/composer-shell.test.tsx, which renders the composer, fails the first send, retries and asserts one create plus an update of the same id, then asserts the empty form and a disabled Send now after success.
